package ui

// The stand-in for video_viewer_hooks_test.go on ui (files-shots' before-ui
// run): ui has no video player, so no viewer item is ever a video.

import (
	"image"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type vvState struct {
	idx, n                int
	video                 bool
	file                  string
	playing, muted, shown bool
	elapsed               time.Duration
	play, mute, bar       image.Rectangle
}

func viewerVideos(t *testing.T) {}

func viewerState(e *perfEnv) (vvState, bool) {
	if vvLightbox(e) == nil {
		return vvState{}, false
	}
	return vvState{n: 1}, true
}

func vvPlayers(e *perfEnv) int { return 0 }

func inlineState(e *perfEnv, ts string) (bool, time.Duration, bool) { return false, 0, false }

func inlineExpand(e *perfEnv, ts string) (image.Rectangle, bool) { return image.Rectangle{}, false }
